subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw accept the v12 per-agent database migration that adds session-owned ACP parent-stream diagnostics as part of this PR’s upgrade contract?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit discussion and acceptance before advancing an SQLite schema version; source review cannot substitute for that owner decision.

options.title: Approve v12 with upgrade proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the v12 schema addition after reviewing evidence that existing agent databases upgrade and ACP diagnostics are retained and deleted with their child session.

options.title: Avoid the schema bump
options.body: Keep ACP diagnostics on an already-approved storage contract or split the persisted table into a separately approved migration.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Defer this refactor until a storage owner confirms the schema and release-upgrade direction.

recommendation.title: Approve v12 with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Explicitly accept the v12 schema addition after reviewing evidence that existing agent databases upgrade and ACP diagnostics are retained and deleted with their child session.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest adjacent history signal for the per-agent SQLite migration boundary introduced by the related merged work.
